mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_tbl ( user_id, user_name, birth_date, carrier_code, phone_number, verification_code, verification_purpose, requested_at, verified_yn, fail_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{birthDate}, #{carrierCode}, #{phoneNumber}, #{verificationCode}, #{verificationPurpose}, #{requestedAt}, #{verifiedYn}, #{failCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, user_id, user_name, birth_date, carrier_code, phone_number, verification_code, verification_purpose, requested_at, verified_yn, fail_count FROM verification_tbl WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND verification_purpose = #{verificationPurpose} ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_tbl SET verified_yn = 'Y' WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND verified_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tbl WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_tbl SET verification_code = #{verificationCode}, requested_at = #{requestedAt}, verified_yn = 'N', fail_count = 0 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.birth_date, u.phone_number, u.pin_password, u.pin_fail_count, u.pin_locked_yn, p.nickname, u.user_status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.withdrawn_at FROM user_tbl u LEFT JOIN profile_tbl p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.phone_number = #{phoneNumber} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_tbl SET pin_fail_count = pin_fail_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pin_fail_count < 5
UPDATE user_tbl SET pin_fail_count = 0, pin_locked_yn = 'N' WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token_tbl ( user_id, refresh_token, expires_at, issued_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiresAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT refresh_token_id, user_id, refresh_token, expires_at, issued_at FROM refresh_token_tbl WHERE refresh_token = #{refreshToken} LIMIT 1

SELECT verification_id FROM verification_tbl WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} AND verification_purpose = 'PIN_RESET' AND verified_yn = 'Y' AND requested_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
